title: vSFT: Learning to Verbally Tune Agents at Test Time
title_zh: vSFT：学习在测试时用语言反馈微调智能体
abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly improved via agentic reinforcement learning, which can be on-policy but suffers from expensive rollouts and sparse rewards, limiting its application at test time. In this paper, we present a verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning (vSFT) framework that enables the conjunction of dense feedback in natural language and weight updates at test time. Specifically, our vSFT forms a closed loop between an agent and a supervisor via a hypernetwork, in which the supervisor generates verbal supervision from the agent's failed trajectories, and the hypernetwork converts that supervision into low-rank weight updates to tune the agent. We validate that this test-time in-parameter evolving process outperforms both its in-context counterparts and prevalent reinforcement learning methods. In particular, our vSFT using Qwen3-4B outperforms GRPO and Reflexion by 8.7% and 13.9% in success rate on ALFWorld, and by 4.8% and 18.2% on WebShop, respectively. We believe that learning how to adapt a model, rather than an adapted model, offers a promising path towards more capable agents that improve themselves.
abstract_zh: 智能体强化学习需要进行成本较高的轨迹采样，且往往面临奖励稀疏的问题，因而难以直接用于测试时适应。本文提出语言监督微调（verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning，vSFT）框架，在测试时将密集的自然语言反馈转化为模型权重更新。具体而言，监督器根据智能体的失败轨迹生成语言反馈，超网络（hypernetwork）再将反馈转换为低秩权重更新，形成从失败反馈到参数调整的闭环。实验表明，这种测试时参数适应优于仅在上下文中适应的方法及常用强化学习基线。以 Qwen3-4B 为基础模型时，vSFT 在 ALFWorld 上的成功率比 GRPO 和 Reflexion 分别高 8.7% 和 13.9%，在 WebShop 上分别高 4.8% 和 18.2%。
key_points_zh: 监督器从失败轨迹中生成密集的自然语言反馈，弥补稀疏奖励的信息不足。
超网络将语言反馈转化为低秩权重更新，使智能体在测试时调整参数，而不只是修改上下文。
基于 Qwen3-4B 的 vSFT 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的成功率均超过 GRPO 和 Reflexion。
方法的重点是学习如何让模型适应新反馈，而不是直接训练出一个已经适应特定任务的模型。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是在测试时从失败轨迹生成文字反馈，再通过超网络将反馈转为低秩权重更新，以改进代理策略。WebShop 上报告了相对 GRPO 和 Reflexion 的量化结果；摘要未提供消融，也未表明生成或验证改进的机制本身会继续改进。
